subject.title: Cron jobs stall during AI model calls (model_call:stream_progress never completes)

question: Should maintainers split Bug 3 into a focused `cron wake mode:"now"` result-contract issue now that the model-call stall is fixed on main, or keep this issue as that tracker?
rationale: The title and most related duplicates are about the now-fixed model-call stall, but source inspection and the latest comment show a different wake result-reporting bug remains; automation should not silently choose the permanent tracker shape.

options.title: Split Bug 3
options.body: Open or designate a focused cron wake result-contract tracker, then close this bundled issue once the split preserves the remaining evidence.

options.title: Keep This Issue As Canonical
options.body: Retitle or clearly scope this issue to the wake result-reporting gap and leave the model-call stall evidence as fixed-on-main context.

options.title: Wait For Next Release Retest
options.body: Keep the bundle unchanged until users retest the main-session and model-call behavior after the next release ships.

recommendation.title: Split Bug 3
recommendation.body: Open or designate a focused cron wake result-contract tracker, then close this bundled issue once the split preserves the remaining evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current status comment and the merged run-lifecycle reliability stack that changed the issue's remaining scope.
